fusions.name: Spore Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts spores over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 9 damage and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Seeding Pellet
fusions.desc: Fires a spore pellet that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lichen Mantle
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each of them is left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Crust
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
